findings.summary: Provider-prior leave-one-out accuracy is 0.833 on selected-playout controls.
Trace-only observation terms did not improve over provider prior.
Explicit provider family, maturity, source-stage, and role fields reproduce the provider-prior signal.
The target is selected-playout success over 42 rows; it is not yet a general strategy ownership target and excludes Stage7 held-out rows from training.
No evidence authorizes a runtime arbiter, selector sandbox, provider bonus, or Stage7 repair.

recommended_next_slice.description: Add a small bounded label slice that separates selected-playout success, forced-provider conversion, same-move compatibility, and guardrail-safe ownership across protected Stage4/5/6 controls while keeping Stage7 residuals held out.
notes: The next slice should first create the bounded label plan, not immediately run a large playout batch.
If existing artifacts already contain enough labels, the plan should point to replay-free extraction instead of new playouts.
